DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書の記入について、迷っている欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any sections of the application form you're unsure how to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の手続きに来ましたが、本人の欄と世帯の欄が並んでいて、家族全員の名前を書くのか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人欄と世帯欄の違いから家族全員を記入するか迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come for my own procedure, but the applicant and household sections are side by side, so I'm unsure whether to write every family member's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the distinction between the applicant and household sections leaves you unsure whether to enter every family member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この手続きで誰の情報が必要かを確かめますので、まず申請する内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check whose information this procedure requires. First, please tell me what you're applying for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私一人の証明をお願いしたくて、この申請書を受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分一人の証明のため申請書を受け取ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like a certificate for just myself, and I was given this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received the form for a certificate for yourself alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、本人の情報が必要な欄を確認しましょう。家族の欄は、必要か担当者に確かめてから書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check the sections requiring your own details. Please ask the staff member whether the family section is needed before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要かまだわからない欄は空けたままにして、番号札を持って担当者へ聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確認の家族欄を空けて担当者へ質問してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I leave sections I'm not yet sure are needed blank, take my numbered ticket and ask the staff member?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave the unconfirmed family section blank and ask the staff member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、推測で書き込まず、どの欄か示してお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Don't fill it in by guessing; point out which section you're asking about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所は新しい部屋のものを書きましたが、本人の名前と同じように読み合わせてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所と本人名の記入内容の読み合わせを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the address of my new apartment, and I'd like it read back with me, just like my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a read-through together of your new address and own name as entered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者にそのご希望を伝えられます。書類を提出する前に、記入内容を一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can tell the staff member that request. Please check the entries together before submitting the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人欄と住所を確かめてもらい、家族の欄は必要だとわかった場合だけ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人情報を確認し必要だとわかった場合だけ家族欄を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have my own details and address checked, and only fill in the family section if I find out it's required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check your own information and enter family details only if confirmed necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請書をお持ちになって、番号が呼ばれたら担当窓口へお進みください。では、よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring the application form and go to the relevant counter when your number is called. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票に薬の名前を書く欄がありますが、お薬の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The medical questionnaire has a space for medicine names. Have you brought information about your medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜飲んだ薬の名前を覚えていないので、捨てずに持ってきた包装を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜の薬名がわからず持参した包装を見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't remember the name of the medicine I took last night, so I'd like you to look at the packaging I brought instead of throwing it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to look at the packaging you brought because you don't know last night's medicine name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 包装を拝見します。飲んだ時刻と量は、ご自分でわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the packaging. Do you know what time you took it and how much?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜九時ごろに一錠飲みましたが、薬の名前は読めずに空欄にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨夜九時ごろ一錠飲み薬名欄は空白にしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took one tablet around nine last night, but can't read the medicine name, so I've left that space blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you took one tablet around nine last night and have left the medicine name blank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を推測せず、包装を医師にもお見せください。ほかに飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't guess the name; show the packaging to the doctor too. Are you taking any other medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎朝の薬もありますが、今日は手帳を忘れたので、家族に写真を送ってもらうつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎朝の薬の手帳を忘れ家族から写真を受け取る予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also take medicine every morning, but forgot my medicine record book today, so I plan to ask my family to send a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot the record book for your morning medicine and plan to get a photo from your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 情報が届いたら職員へお知らせください。今は手帳を忘れたことを書いておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell a staff member when the information arrives. For now, let's note that you forgot the book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真が届く前に呼ばれた場合は、まだ確認できていない薬があると伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真未着で診察に呼ばれた場合の説明方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I'm called in before the photo arrives, should I explain that there's a medicine I haven't been able to confirm yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how to explain if called for examination before the photo arrives. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認できたことと未確認のことを分けて、医師へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Tell the doctor separately what you've confirmed and what remains unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜の薬の包装と一錠飲んだ時刻を示し、毎朝の薬は写真を待っていると説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨夜の包装と服用状況を示し毎朝の薬は確認待ちと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show last night's packaging and the time I took one tablet, and explain that I'm waiting for the photo of my morning medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show last night's packaging and dosage details, and say the morning medicine is awaiting confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 包装は診察までお持ちください。では、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the packaging with you until your examination. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物について伺います。どのような物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'd like to ask about what you lost. What sort of item is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日なくした長い傘を探していて、店にも聞きましたが見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店にも聞いたが昨日なくした長傘が見つからないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for a long umbrella I lost yesterday. I asked at the shop too, but it wasn't found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that yesterday's lost long umbrella hasn't been found even after asking the shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色や形など、見分けられる特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me distinguishing features such as its color and shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 布は濃い緑で、持ち手に白いひもを結んでありますが、模様を言葉で説明しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 濃緑の布と白いひもを述べ模様の説明が難しいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The fabric is dark green, and there's a white cord tied to the handle, but the pattern is hard to describe in words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the dark green fabric and white cord, and say the pattern is difficult to explain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 簡単な絵でも結構です。模様の形を、この欄に描いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: A simple drawing is fine too. Try drawing the pattern's shapes in this space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい四角が並んだ柄なので、こんなふうに描けば伝わるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 並んだ小さい四角の柄を絵にして確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a pattern of small squares in rows. Would drawing it like this get it across?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Draw the pattern of small squares in rows and ask them to check it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴がわかりますね。最後に傘を見た場所と時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That makes its features clear. Please also tell me where and when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方六時ごろ、店の入口の傘立てに置いたのが最後で、その後は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日十八時ごろ店入口の傘立てで最後に見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The last time was around six yesterday evening, when I put it in the umbrella stand at the shop entrance. I haven't seen it since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you last saw it around six yesterday evening in the umbrella stand at the shop entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況を記録します。連絡先を書いたあと、傘の特徴と一緒に内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record those circumstances. After entering your contact details, check the information together with the umbrella's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を書き、緑の布と白いひもと四角の柄が記録されているか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を書き布の色とひもと模様の記録を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll enter my contact details and check that the green fabric, white cord and square pattern are recorded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter your contact details and compare the recorded fabric color, cord and pattern. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届け出の内容を確認できました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the contents of your report. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小包の宛名を拝見します。番地の数字が少し読みづらいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me look at the parcel address. The street number is a little hard to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書いてからインクがにじんでしまい、一か七か見分けにくいので、このまま送るのは心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: にじんだ番地が一か七か判別できず発送が心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The ink smudged after I wrote it, and it's hard to tell whether it's one or seven. I'm worried about sending it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the smudged street number could be one or seven and you're worried about mailing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送り先の正しい番地を確かめて、読みやすく書き直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Check the recipient's correct street number and rewrite it legibly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元の住所は電話のメッセージに残っているので、それを見ながら新しいラベルを書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存した住所メッセージを参照して宛名ラベルを書き直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The original address is saved in a message on my phone, so I'd like to write a new label while looking at that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to rewrite the address label using the saved address message. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しいラベルをご用意します。古い表示と食い違わないよう、貼り方も確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll get you a new label. Let's also check how to attach it so it doesn't conflict with the old information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージの番地は七でしたので、新しいラベルには七と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メッセージで番地が七と確認し新ラベルに記入したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The street number in the message was seven, so I've written seven on the new label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report confirming the number is seven in the message and writing it on the new label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み取れますね。宛名のほかに、差出人の欄もご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's readable. In addition to the recipient, please fill in the sender section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 差出人の住所は裏側に書いてありましたが、このラベルの欄にも必要なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏側の差出人住所に加えてラベル欄も記入する必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote my sender address on the back, but it's needed in this label's section too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you must enter the label section as well as the sender address on the back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な欄をこのラベルでご案内します。書き終えたら、古い宛名が見える状態で渡さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you the required sections on this label. When you've finished, don't hand it over with the old address still visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 差出人欄を記入し、古い宛名をどう隠すか確認してから小包を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人欄を書き古い宛名の隠し方を確かめて小包を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill in the sender section, check how to cover the old address, then hand over the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in the sender section, check how to hide the old address and hand over the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛名の確認が済んだらお預かりします。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll accept it once the address check is complete. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認画面でお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the transfer confirmation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込もうとしましたが、画面に出た受取人の名前が請求書と違うので、まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 振込画面の受取人が請求書と異なり確定していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I tried to transfer my rent, but the recipient name on the screen differs from the invoice, so I haven't confirmed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the transfer screen's recipient differs from the invoice and you haven't confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確定せずに止めたのですね。入力した銀行名と口座番号を、手元の書類と比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you stopped without confirming. Compare the bank name and account number you entered with your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は一致していますが、請求書は会社名で、画面には個人の名前が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座番号は同じだが請求書は会社名で画面は個人名と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number matches, but the invoice has a company name and the screen shows an individual's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the account number matches but the invoice names a company and the screen an individual. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは請求書の正当性を判断できません。請求元へ、振込先の情報を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't judge the invoice's legitimacy here. Check the transfer destination details with the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書にある電話だけでなく、以前から使っている管理会社の連絡先へ聞くことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前からの管理会社の連絡先で振込先を確認する方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask through the management company's contact details I've used before, rather than only the number on the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the transfer destination using the management company's previously used contact details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、確認が取れるまでは送金を進めないでください。画面の操作でお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, don't proceed with sending money until you've confirmed. Is there anything about operating the screen you need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確定せずに入力を取り消したいので、最初の画面へ戻る操作を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込を確定せず入力を取り消して初期画面へ戻る操作を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to cancel the entries without confirming. Please show me how to return to the initial screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to cancel the entries without confirming the transfer and return to the initial screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取消の表示を選び、振込が完了した表示が出ていないことを確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Select the cancel option and check that no transfer-completed message is showing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入力を取り消して画面を戻し、管理会社から確認が取れるまで振り込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入力を取り消して管理会社の確認まで送金しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll cancel the entries and return to the first screen, and won't transfer until I've checked with the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to cancel the entries and not send money until management confirms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 取消後の画面をご確認ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the screen after cancellation. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お米の袋を比べていらっしゃいますね。どの表示をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're comparing bags of rice. Which information are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい袋のほうが安いと聞きましたが、値札の大きな数字だけ見ると高くて、比べ方がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 米の大袋の総額が高く単価の比べ方がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the larger bag is cheaper, but just looking at the large number on the price tag, it's more expensive. I don't know how to compare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the large rice bag's total is higher and you don't know how to compare unit prices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きな数字は袋全体の値段です。同じ重さあたりの価格も、別の欄で見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The large number is the whole bag's price. Compare the price per equal weight in the separate section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一キロあたりの欄なら、袋の重さが違っても比べられるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一キロあたり表示なら重さの異なる袋を比較できると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this per-kilogram section lets me compare bags of different weights, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that per-kilogram information lets you compare bags of different weights. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。ただ、価格だけでなく、運べる重さや使い切る量も考えてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. But choose with the weight you can carry and the amount you can finish in mind, not just the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は自転車で来たので、安くても五キロの袋を安全に運べるか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車で五キロ袋を安全に運べるか自信がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came by bicycle today, so even if it's cheap, I'm not sure I can carry a five-kilogram bag safely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you're unsure you can transport a five-kilogram bag safely by bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かごの大きさや荷物の重さによりますね。無理に持ち帰らず、小さい袋も候補にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It depends on your basket size and the weight of your load. Don't force yourself to carry it home; consider a smaller bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二キロの袋なら持ちやすそうなので、こちらの袋全体の金額を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運びやすい二キロ袋の全体価格を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: A two-kilogram bag looks easier to carry, so I'd like to check the price of this whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the total price of the easier-to-carry two-kilogram bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この値札の商品名と二キロの表示が、袋に合っているか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check whether the product name and two-kilogram indication on this price tag match the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 商品名と二キロが一致したので、今回は小袋を一つ選び、ほかの重い物は買わずに帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名と二キロ表示を照合して小袋だけ購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The product name and two kilograms match, so I'll choose one small bag this time and go home without buying other heavy things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the product name and two-kilogram indication and buy only the small bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない量でお選びください。お買い物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose an amount you can manage. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチの近くで何か見つけられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find something near a bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子ども用の水筒がベンチの下にあったので、忘れ物かもしれないと思ってお知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベンチ下の子ども用水筒を忘れ物と思い職員へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a child's water bottle under a bench. I thought someone might have left it behind, so came to let you know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell staff about a child's bottle under a bench that you think is lost property. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どのベンチか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Could you tell me which bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二つ目のベンチで、座る面の右側の下に、黄色いひもの付いた水筒があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口から二番目のベンチ右下の黄色いひも付き水筒を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second bench from the entrance. There's a bottle with a yellow strap underneath the right side of the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the yellow-strapped bottle under the right side of the second bench from the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所がわかりました。ご自身で持って来られましたか、それともそのままですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I know where that is. Did you bring it yourself, or is it still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 誰の物かわからないので持ち上げず、そのまま置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち主不明のため触らず元の位置に置いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't know whose it is, so I haven't picked it up and have left it where it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you left it untouched in its original position because the owner is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職員が確認します。そちらへ行くまで、ベンチの位置をもう一度この図で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will check. Until we go there, let's confirm the bench's location again on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この入口から数えて二つ目でしたが、図ではベンチの数が少なく見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現地のベンチ数と案内図の数が異なることを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was the second one counting from this entrance, but the map seems to show fewer benches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out that the number of benches on site differs from the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図にすべてのベンチが載っているとは限りませんね。入口からの順番を手がかりに現地で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The map may not show every bench. We'll check on site using its order from the entrance as a clue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図だけで決めずに入口から二つ目を見ていただければ、私はこのあと散歩へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図だけでなく入口からの順番で確認を依頼して散歩へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: If you could check the second one from the entrance rather than decide from the map alone, I'll go back to my walk now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a check by order from the entrance as well as the map, then return to your walk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございました。どうぞ、引き続き公園でお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please enjoy the rest of your time in the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札にはまだ入られていませんね。切符についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You haven't entered the ticket gates yet, right? Is this about a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行き先を押し間違えて、この一つ手前の駅までの切符を買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行き先を一駅手前に押し間違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I pressed the wrong destination and bought a ticket to the station one stop before this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you selected the wrong destination, one station too early. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際にはどの駅まで行かれるご予定ですか。切符と一緒に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which station do you actually plan to go to? Please tell me and show the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの駅までです。券売機の路線図で、隣の名前を押してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望の到着駅と路線図での押し間違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This station here. On the ticket machine's route map, I pressed the neighboring name by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your desired arrival station and the mistaken selection on the route map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行き先の表示を確認しますね。お持ちの切符での変更方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the destination shown. I'll explain how to change the ticket you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 間違えた切符は券売機へ戻して操作するのですか。窓口で見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券売機へ戻すか窓口で確認するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Do I put the incorrect ticket back into the machine and operate it? Could the counter check it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to put it back in the machine or have the counter check it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械を操作する前に、窓口でこの切符を確認しましょう。購入した方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before operating the machine, let's check this ticket at the counter. Please also tell me how you bought it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で買いました。新しい切符の分も全部払うのか、差額だけなのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金購入と伝え全額か差額か確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I bought it with cash. I'd like to know whether I pay the full price of a new ticket or just the difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you paid cash and ask whether the full amount or only the difference is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 扱いを確認して、必要な金額をお伝えします。金額をご確認いただいてから進めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the procedure and tell you the required amount. We'll proceed after you check that amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額と行き先を確認してから手続きをお願いします。改札へは新しい切符を受け取ってから入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額と行先を確認し変更後の切符で入場すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please handle it after I've checked the amount and destination. I'll enter the gates after receiving the new ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the amount and destination and enter with the changed ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、順番にご案内します。それでは、窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll guide you through it in order. Please come to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入は進みましたか。空いている欄について確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is the form coming along? Shall we check the empty sections?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 緊急連絡先の欄にも、自分の携帯番号をもう一度書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 緊急連絡先にも本人番号を繰り返して書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I write my own mobile number again in the emergency contact section too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to repeat your own number for the emergency contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この用紙では、ご本人と連絡が取れないときの連絡先を記入する欄です。連絡できる方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this form, that section is for someone to contact when we can't reach you. Is there someone we can contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ家に住む兄がいます。ただ、兄は仕事中に電話へ出られないことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居の兄がいるが仕事中に応答できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My older brother lives with me. But sometimes he can't answer while working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your older brother lives with you but may not answer during work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡先を記入してよいか、まずお兄様にも確かめてください。続柄は「兄」と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, check with your brother whether you may enter his contact details. Write “older brother” for the relationship.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今電話で確かめたところ、番号を書いてよいと言っていました。会社の電話も書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄の同意を確認し会社番号も必要か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I just checked by phone, and he said I can write his number. Do I need his work number too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your brother's consent and ask whether his company number is also needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄は一つですから、まずお兄様の携帯番号を書いてください。会社の番号は勝手に追加しないで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's only one space here, so first write your brother's mobile number. You don't need to add his company number on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 兄の名前と携帯番号、続柄を書きます。私の番号は上の本人連絡先に書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄の情報と本人番号を別欄に書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write his name, mobile number and relationship. My own number goes in the applicant contact section above, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll put your brother's information and own number in separate sections. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その二つを分けてご記入ください。書き終わったら番号の桁も見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, fill those two in separately. When finished, let's also check the number of digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人欄と兄の欄を別に書いて、携帯番号が抜けていないか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と兄を分けて記入し番号の桁を見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my own section and my brother's separately and check that no digits are missing from the mobile numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll fill in your own and brother's details separately and recheck the number of digits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。ご記入ありがとうございました、提出窓口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Thank you for filling it in. The submission counter is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の案内票をお持ちですね。こちらは画像検査の受付ですが、お探しの場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the examination information slip. This is imaging reception; which place are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 採血に来たのですが、この部屋の前で待っていました。場所を間違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血予定なのに別検査室の前で待っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came for a blood draw, but was waiting outside this room. It seems I've come to the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you waited outside another examination room despite being scheduled for a blood draw. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内票を見せてください。採血室の表示を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the slip. Let's check the blood collection room sign together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。「採血」と書いてあるのは読めますが、矢印を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内票を提示し採血表示は読めたが矢印を見落としたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is it. I can read “blood collection,” but missed the arrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the slip and say you read the blood collection text but overlooked the arrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 採血室はこの廊下を戻って、右側にあります。案内票はその受付にお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Go back along this corridor; the blood collection room is on the right. Hand your slip in at that reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで十分ほど待ってしまいました。先に採血室へ事情を伝えたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十分待ったため採血室で事情を先に伝えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've waited here about ten minutes. Should I explain the situation to blood collection reception first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to explain the situation first at blood collection after waiting ten minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 着いたら受付の方に、違う場所で待っていたとお伝えください。検査の順番はそちらで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you arrive, tell reception you were waiting in the wrong place. Check the examination order there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。廊下を戻って右ですね、採血室には今から行ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 廊下を戻って右と復唱し今移動してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Back along the corridor and on the right, yes? May I go to the blood collection room now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat back along the corridor and right, and ask whether you may go now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内票を持ってお進みください。途中で迷ったら近くの職員に紙を見せてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, take your slip and go ahead. If you lose your way, show the paper to a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 採血室の受付で紙を出し、別の部屋の前で待っていたことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採血受付で案内票と待ち場所の間違いを伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hand in the paper at blood collection reception and explain that I was waiting outside another room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll show the slip and explain the wrong waiting location at blood collection reception. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけてお進みください。それでは、採血室の受付へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care as you go. Please head to blood collection reception.
